active: active (L1 cards + L2 folds + local archive)

help.title: Strata Context: /strata commands
help.status: Short summary: context use, layers, cache hit rate
help.detail: Detail in sections, for troubleshooting: overview, layers, automatic folds, foldable ranges, cache and cost, recent changes
help.detailFull: Detail plus every message in each foldable range
help.purge: Delete this session's archive files (asks for confirmation)
help.purgeEnded: Delete the archives of ended sessions (asks to confirm)

purge.warning: /strata purge deletes ALL local archive files of THIS session. It cannot be undone: folds and cards already in the conversation stay, but their originals can no longer be restored from the archive (the DSH session log still has the original events).
purge.confirm: To delete them, send: /strata purge confirm
purge.done: Deleted {files} archive files ({mb} MB) for this session. Folds and cards already in the conversation stay; their originals can no longer be restored from the archive (the DSH session log still has the original events).

detail.title: Strata Context: {state}
detail.ruleOn: at turn end above {pct} after {nudges} unanswered reminders, or above {force}; oldest work first, down to ~{target} (fixed overhead + {targetPct} of the room left)
detail.ruleOnSingle: at turn end above {force}; oldest work first, down to ~{target} (fixed overhead + {targetPct} of the room left)
detail.ruleMidTurn: ; mid-turn above {force}, earlier turns are digested first
detail.ranges: 4. Foldable ranges (local estimate ~{tokens} in total, ~{provider} by the provider's count)
detail.netValue: ~{tokens} tokens at the miss price (hit/miss price {ratio})
detail.archiveOver: , above the {cap} MB warning (nothing is deleted; /strata purge ended cleans up)
detail.officialClamped: ; lines lowered to {pct} for this window
detail.officialNoStage: ; the two lines merge into one, no waiting for reminders
detail.officialUnknown: unknown (the window cannot hold output and headroom)
detail.ruleMidTurnCurrent: ; mid-turn above {force}, earlier turns are digested first, then this turn's finished tool rounds
detail.warnConfig: DSH's automatic compaction is off for {target}: {message}
detail.warnOfficial: DSH's official summary (L∞) failed {count} time(s) in a row: {message}
detail.lastErrorDock: [the dock shows this in red for 10 minutes or until the next landing]
detail.rangeFoldNote: {example}: a fold boundary. The ref in brackets is the fold's own position, written when it landed, so it is larger than the messages after it; compress takes the refs as they are ({compress}).
detail.paybackValue: last change {id}: ~{payback} requests to pay back, {since} so far{landing}
detail.paybackNever: last change {id}: reclaims nothing per request, never pays back{landing}
detail.paybackFree: last change {id}: no re-billing, nothing to pay back
detail.landingCost: (passed the cost check: expected ~{remaining} more requests)
detail.landingForced: (landed above the force line; cost check skipped)
detail.landingPressured: (landed above the automatic-fold line with the digests; cost check skipped)
detail.projectedValue: ~{tokens} tokens once the expected requests have run (the cost checks' estimate)
detail.netEarly: ; negative right after a landing is expected: the re-billing is paid at once, the saving comes per request
detail.lastRejectionValue: {time}  {what}: {message}  (a check refused it; not a failure, the dock stays as it is)
detail.ruleOnNoNudge: at turn end above {pct} (reminders are off, so no waiting for them); oldest work first, down to ~{target} (fixed overhead + {targetPct} of the room left)
detail.ruleGrowth: ; after one lands, the next waits until about {step} more can be folded, or usage passes {forced} (the force line, a fallback)

purgeEnded.warning: /strata purge ended deletes the local archives of ended sessions: {sessions} session(s), {mb} MB (not this session, sessions open in this process, or sessions another running DSH is writing). This cannot be undone: if you reopen those sessions, their folds and cards can no longer be restored from the archive (DSH's session log still holds the original events).
purgeEnded.confirm: To delete them, send: /strata purge ended confirm
purgeEnded.done: Deleted the archives of {sessions} ended session(s): {files} files, {mb} MB.
purgeEnded.none: No archives of ended sessions to delete.

outcome.belowForce: skipped ({ratio}: below {force} and {unanswered} of {needed} unanswered nudges)
outcome.waitGrowth: skipped (just tidied: waiting for about {step} more foldable content by the provider's count, ~{local} local; {sofar} local so far)
outcome.unreachable: skipped (target ~{target} unreachable: what is left is {current}fixed, protected or already folded)
outcome.proposedStop: ; stopped before {ref} (~{tokens}) to stay near the target
outcome.overshoot: skipped (the oldest round {ref}, ~{tokens}, would overshoot the target ~{target} by more than half)
outcome.noRun: skipped (no foldable run outside pending folds{current})
outcome.notLandedSmall: proposed {ids}, not landed (batch ~{batch} below the {min} minimum)

marker.line: Strata tidied what the model sees: {parts}; {records} records, about {tokens} tokens. The conversation here is unchanged; the originals stay in the local archive and can be restored.
marker.card: turned {count} older tool output(s) into a card

rejection.small: too little to reclaim: ~{tokens}, below the {min} minimum per landing
rejection.payback: not worth it: ~{miss} would be re-billed and {after}{limit}
rejection.paybackAfter: it pays back only after {n} requests
rejection.cardNotSmaller: the card (~{card}) is not smaller than the original (~{span})
rejection.summaryNotSmaller: the summary (~{summary}) is not smaller than the range (~{range})
rejection.shadowNotSmaller: the summary ({summary}) is not smaller than what it replaces ({range})
rejection.foldNotSmaller: the fold ({fold}) is not smaller than its range ({range})
rejection.spanGone: the selected range is no longer in the context
rejection.largerRange: ; pick a larger range or leave it
rejection.shorterSummary: ; pick a larger range or write a shorter summary
rejection.protected: {ref} is protected ({why}); the range must end before it
rejection.officialSummary: the range contains an official summary, which is never folded again
rejection.maxTier: the range contains a T{top} fold; T{max} is the highest tier
rejection.splitsCall: {ref} would split a tool call from its result
rejection.leavesCall: {ref} would leave a tool call without its result
rejection.notOnSurface: {ref} is no longer in the context

plain.whatAuto: folded older work into summaries automatically
plain.whatModel: the model folded older work into summaries
plain.whatCard: turned an older tool output into a card
plain.usage: Now: the context is about {pct} full ({used} / {window})
plain.nextOff: Next: automatic tidy-ups are off; only the model's own folds and DSH's official summary
plain.nextLine: Next: at about {pct} it tidies up at the end of that turn
plain.nextNudge: Next: at about {pct} it reminds the model to fold; after {n} unanswered reminders, or at {force}, it tidies up at turn end
plain.nextAbove: Next: past the {pct} line, it tidies up at the end of this turn if needed
plain.nextMidTurn: ; above {force} it also tidies up mid-turn
plain.savedNote: ~{reclaimed} freed in all; "saved" is priced at cache rates, re-billing deducted (see /strata detail)
plain.rejection: {time} a {what} was skipped: {reason} (a check stopped it; not a failure)
plain.intro: Strata is working: mode {mode}. Change it in Plugins → Strata Context → Strata settings.
plain.lastNoneRestart: Last: nothing tidied since DSH started; the conversation already has {folds} fold(s) and {cards} card(s).
plain.nextWaitNudge: Next: past {pct}; after {left} more unanswered reminder(s), or at {force}, it tidies up at turn end
plain.nextWaitGrowth: Next: just tidied; it tidies again at turn end once about {step} of new content builds up (about {sofar} so far), or usage reaches {forced} (the fallback line)
